main_all_tasks_bounds.interpretation: Bounds, not confidence intervals: allow canonical two-second random-search success to range from zero to one.

methods.random_search: Average 1-(1-p_g)^8 across tasks, with p_g equal to successful/valid saved-grid placements. Each trial resets the same world. This is uniform grid search, not retry-only LMM behavior.
methods.random_distinct: Sensitivity for eight distinct valid grid placements: 1-product_{j=0..7}(1-K_g/(N_g-j)).
methods.random_scope: 1560 noncanonical goals have compatible saved densities; 1509 are in the primary 1641-task set. Canonical132 has a saved three-second solution proxy, not a matched two-second density, and is excluded from the point baseline.
methods.random_uncertainty: Intervals resample whole layouts, conditional on fixed saved-grid densities. They do not estimate discretization error or success-density uncertainty over continuous placements.
methods.no_motion: Predict each scored dynamic object stays at its simulator initial center; predict PLACED stays at the supplied chosen/probe placement. Predict no exits. Static objects are excluded exactly as in model PQ. Uses exact scene geometry, without perceptual localization error.
methods.PQ: Average exp(-squared_endpoint_error/(2*150^2)) over the same objects as the model score. Actual exits score zero for no-motion. Invalid/missing model forecasts retain the original zero credit.
methods.pairing: Compare each model with no-motion on that model’s exact actions, probe placements, objects, checkpoints and task population. Differences are paired, not differences between independently sampled averages.
methods.intervals: Pointwise whole-layout percentile bootstrap; retain all goals, directions and attempts. Conditional chosen groups use inverse episode-length weights matching Figure 4A. Other groups weight episodes equally.
methods.causal_scope: Beating random search indicates useful action selection relative to this reference; it does not isolate feedback learning. Full-feedback versus retry remains the matched feedback-use comparison.
methods.qualitative_prediction: The response schema requests terminal object states, endpoints, exit sides and optional orientation. Collision and movement events define goals/diagnostics; no separately scored prospective collision/movement prediction is part of these results.
